title: salix × ambigua var. longifolia
intro: Salix × ambigua var. longifolia, commonly known as Willow, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Salicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and analgesic properties. The therapeutic actions of Salix × ambigua var. longifolia include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and relieving pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salicin, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
